meta.interpretationBoundary: The sample demonstrates report structure only and does not describe a real organization.

executiveThesis.headline: Move the team from weekly evidence assembly to continuously prepared decisions
executiveThesis.narrative: The team already has one consumed weekly decision system. The next operating-model move is to connect customer language, creative priorities, and production handoff while preserving explicit human approval.

synthesis.manualCoordination: Customer-language synthesis, context assembly, and production handoff are rebuilt manually around the Monday review.
decisionsPrepared: Which customer objection needs a new test
synthesis.highestCapacityUnlock: A connected weekly creative operating loop that prepares evidence before the meeting and carries approved decisions into production.
synthesis.mondayChange: The team arrives to a current decision brief, reviews exceptions, and approves priorities instead of rebuilding context live.

proposedSystems.name: Continuous customer-language intelligence
proposedSystems.currentGap: Customer language is synthesized manually and the existing refresh lacks qualified ownership and consumption evidence.
proposedSystems.trigger: Weekly source refresh plus new evidence threshold
proposedSystems.aiRole: Normalize new language, retain verbatim evidence, and surface changed pain, desire, objection, and proof themes.
proposedSystems.humanRole: A strategist approves theme changes and claims before they enter briefs.
proposedSystems.output: Current customer-language evidence bank and change brief
proposedSystems.successSignal: The strategist approves the update and the weekly priority brief cites it repeatedly.
proposedSystems.rationale: This removes recurring evidence assembly while keeping messaging judgment human.

proposedSystems.name: Weekly creative priority orchestrator
proposedSystems.currentGap: The existing decision brief stops at recommendation and the producer handoff is reconstructed manually.
proposedSystems.aiRole: Convert accepted priorities into a production-ready queue with evidence, owner, due point, and approval status.
proposedSystems.humanRole: The growth lead approves priorities; the producer accepts capacity and sequencing.
proposedSystems.ownerRecommendation: Growth lead with producer as downstream owner
proposedSystems.successSignal: Approved priorities appear in production without context being recopied.
proposedSystems.rationale: This closes the strongest observed handoff gap around an already consumed system.

proposedSystems.name: Creative learning and iteration loop
proposedSystems.currentGap: Results are reviewed weekly but accepted lessons are not maintained as durable rules for the next cycle.
proposedSystems.trigger: A test reaches the agreed evidence threshold
proposedSystems.aiRole: Prepare the performance and creative evidence, propose the lesson, and identify the next iteration.
proposedSystems.humanRole: The strategist approves the lesson; the growth lead approves the next test.
proposedSystems.output: Approved learning record and iteration brief
proposedSystems.destination: Creative knowledge base and production queue
proposedSystems.successSignal: Approved learnings are reused in later briefs and linked to the tests that produced them.
proposedSystems.rationale: This converts weekly review into cumulative learning rather than repeated interpretation.
